summary: Full E2E backend + frontend test of AI Trading Bot. 17/22 backend tests pass. Core blocker: Alpha Vantage market data integration fails for XAUUSD (invalid API call for CURRENCY_EXCHANGE_RATE with XAU) and free-tier rate limit (25 req/day) is exhausted, which in turn breaks AI signal generation (depends on get_quote + get_history). Frontend renders cleanly, login/navigation/sidebar/mobile responsiveness all work; price tiles and chart show 'NO DATA AVAILABLE' due to backend market data failures.

critical.issue: Alpha Vantage returns 'Invalid API call' for CURRENCY_EXCHANGE_RATE with from_currency=XAU. XAU/gold is no longer supported on this endpoint — must use a different AV function (e.g. FX_DAILY with appropriate mapping or a different gold source). Causes 502 on /api/market/quote/XAUUSD and /api/market/history/XAUUSD, cascading to signal generation and the entire dashboard chart.

Alpha Vantage free tier rate limit (25 req/day) exhausted. BTCUSD and others return 502. With only 25 req/day shared across all symbols + history + quotes, this app is not viable without (a) a paid AV key, or (b) much more aggressive caching, or (c) a fallback data provider.

Returns 502 because it transitively calls get_quote + get_history which fail (see above). Claude API call itself never gets to execute. Signal generation, trade execute, and bridge poll-flow are therefore untestable end-to-end.

minor.issue: Pydantic EmailStr rejects @test.local and other RFC reserved TLDs (422). Not a bug per se, but documenting that test data must use real-looking TLDs (e.g. @example.com).
Untested end-to-end because signal generation fails. Endpoint structure looks correct from code review.

ui_bugs.issue: data-testid='account-form' is conditional — only mounted after clicking 'ADD ACCOUNT'. Tests/automation expecting the form on initial render will miss it. Suggest always rendering or adding data-testid on the toggle button.
Shows '+0.00%' and 'NO DATA AVAILABLE' because backend market endpoints are 502. Functionality of UI itself is correct — symptom of backend issue.

integration_issues.issue: Generate Signals button can be clicked but POST /api/signals/generate returns 502 due to AV chain failure. UI shows error toast.

issues: Clean dark theme with sufficient contrast (green accent on near-black background, white body text). No alignment / spacing issues observed at 1920x1080 or 375x800.

action_items: Fix XAUUSD quote/history: Alpha Vantage CURRENCY_EXCHANGE_RATE no longer accepts XAU. Either (a) switch XAUUSD to a different AV endpoint (e.g. FX_DAILY isn't supported for XAU either — consider using a metals-specific provider or scraping XAU through a different symbol mapping), or (b) use FX_INTRADAY/COMMODITIES endpoint, or (c) add a non-AV fallback for gold.

Address Alpha Vantage 25 req/day rate limit: increase cache TTL (current quote=60s, history=6h is ok), upgrade to paid AV key, or add a secondary data provider (Twelve Data, Polygon, CoinGecko for crypto).
Make data-testid='account-form' present in DOM at all times (or move testid to the 'Add Account' button) so deterministic E2E selectors work.

Cloudflare ingress is converting backend 502 responses into a full HTML Cloudflare error page (clients lose the JSON detail). Consider returning a different status (e.g. 503 with retry-after, or 200 + error envelope) so the frontend can display useful messages.
Re-run /api/signals/generate end-to-end after market data is fixed — Claude wiring itself was not exercised in this iteration.
critical_code_review_comments: market.py: XAU treated as currency in CURRENCY_EXCHANGE_RATE — Alpha Vantage rejects this. Needs a dedicated commodities path or third-party metals API.

market.py: history cache is 6h but quote cache is 60s. With 25 req/day cap and 13 supported symbols, even 60s caching guarantees burn-through. Recommend extending quote cache to 5-15min or shared per-minute throttle.
ai_signals.py: silently swallows JSON parse errors and returns HOLD with confidence=0. OK behaviour, but log the raw response when parse fails for debugging.

auth.py + routes: cookie SameSite='None' + Secure is correct for cross-site usage. httpOnly is set. bcrypt hash format ($2b$) confirmed via working login. Brute-force lockout is NOT implemented — security gap (not in current scope but flagging).

bridge_routes.py + trade_routes.py: account_id is stored as the string form of ObjectId — works, but consistency-wise consider validating that incoming account_id is a valid ObjectId before find_one to avoid 500s on malformed input.

signal_routes.py /generate-all: not exercised (per agent_to_agent_context_note). When AV is healthy, this will burn 2 quote + 2 history requests per call = 4/25 daily budget per click. Consider gating behind a debounce or active-bot loop only.

success_rate.frontend: 85% (login + nav + responsive OK; data display blocked by backend)

test_credentials: admin@trading.bot / admin123 (works). Test users created via /api/auth/register must use @example.com (not @test.local — Pydantic EmailStr rejects reserved TLDs).
seed_data_creation: None — used registration to create per-test users. All test users use 'test_' prefix in email local-part.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py with classes TestHealth, TestAuth, TestMarket, TestBotConfig, TestAccounts, TestEAScript, TestSignals, TestTradeBridge. Signals + trade-bridge classes will only pass once Alpha Vantage XAUUSD + rate-limit issues are resolved (Claude call itself is gated behind market data). Frontend account form testid is conditional — click the toggle button first. Mobile responsiveness verified at 375px width.
rca of the issue: Alpha Vantage's CURRENCY_EXCHANGE_RATE endpoint stopped accepting XAU as from_currency on the free tier (returns 'Invalid API call'). Combined with the 25 req/day cap which was hit during this test run (multiple quote + history calls for XAUUSD/BTCUSD/multi-symbol tests), all market endpoints for these two symbols now 502. Because ai_signals.analyze_symbol awaits get_quote and get_history before calling Claude, every /api/signals/generate request raises before reaching the LLM and returns 502. The frontend dashboard tiles, chart, and signals page therefore all show empty/error states even though the FastAPI routes and DB persistence are themselves correct.
